title: chenopodium roseum
intro: Chenopodium roseum, commonly known as sand spinach, is a type of succulent plant that belongs to the Amaranthaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region, and its leaves are edible and rich in nutrients, providing health benefits such as high levels of vitamins A and C, as well as minerals like potassium and iron. The therapeutic actions of Chenopodium roseum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can be beneficial in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
